verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer offers web-based client tools (GDHQ, Contract Generator, D&O Questionnaire Portal, Catalyze), so asking whether an API matches the UI is a fair question. However, no evidence documents any public API, let alone one with parity to the UI. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
